header.title: Shadows
header.description: Shadows, z-index and elevation: --gem-shadow-* / --gem-z-* CSS variables and shadow, zIndex and elevation helpers.

intro: Shadows communicate elevation; z-index controls stacking order. Use the semantic elevation map when a surface needs both.

zIndex.title: Z-index scale
zIndex.description: zIndex / --gem-z-*. Gaps between layers leave room for one-off values without collisions.

elevation.title: Semantic elevation
elevation.description: Each elevation level pairs a shadow with a z-index.

stacking.title: Stacking order
stacking.description: Typical stacking: overlay → modal → toast → tooltip. Classes .gem-z-* and .gem-shadow-* map 1:1 to tokens.

applied.title: Applied code
applied.description: Examples with CSS variables and the TypeScript helpers.

playground.title: Apply elevation
playground.description: Pick an elevation token and apply it to the panel. Both box-shadow and z-index update together.
playground.label: Elevation
